Title: Demo queues nearly empty after seed
Steps to reproduce: Run seed; count PENDING claims by step
Expected: Several claims pending at MANAGER/AUDITOR/HEAD and in SAMPLE_AUDIT for demo users
Actual: Only 1 AUDITOR-step and 1 SAMPLE_AUDIT claim; demo manager had 1 pending
Fix: Weekday bias, 10% big-ticket travel, demo team files more often, recent claims stay pending

Title: Weekend flag on 48% of seeded claims
Fix: Shift 85% of weekend dates to Friday

Title: Oldest-pending alert firing at baseline
How found: Prometheus query after first compose up
Expected: Healthy baseline < 72h so the alert means something
Fix: Seeded pending claims entered their step within the last 46h

Title: Total spend KPI wraps onto two lines
Fix: Use whole-rupee format for KPI tile

Title: Chart labels truncated
Steps to reproduce: Open Dashboard; look at Policy violations by rule

Title: Stuck claim not findable by finance head during incident
Steps to reproduce: Backdate a MANAGER-step claim; as head open Audit queue
Expected: Responder can find the stale claim in the UI
Actual: Queue only lists claims the user can act on; drill log shows find claim: #1611 '?'
Fix: New read-only 'All pending (oversight)' view + regression test

Title: Missing clickjacking / referrer headers
Fix: Add X-Frame-Options DENY and Referrer-Policy same-origin

Title: E2E-01 failed once right after container restart
Steps to reproduce: Rebuild app container and immediately run suite
Actual: Timeout on first test (cold start); passes on rerun and in later full runs
Fix: Recorded as flaky-on-cold-start; run suite after healthcheck passes (compose --wait)

Title: Test asserted wrong wording for role guard
Actual: App correctly showed "Not available for your role"; test looked for "permission"
Fix: Fixed the test and added an API 403 assertion

Title: Validation errors shown at form level not next to the field
Steps to reproduce: Save a line with a future date
Expected: Message next to the offending line
Actual: Server returns one string; UI shows a form-level alert naming the line
Fix: Message names the line number (e.g. 'Line 2: date cannot be in the future'); field-level mapping is backlog
